newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle moderate at $70 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle moderate at $70 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady with last week's close. Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 4,000 slaughter steers and 4,400 heifers; 22,900 head confirmed for the week which includes 12,200 formulated and 1,700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 70.00, few North Plains 71.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 70.00, few North Plains 71.00. Few pens Select, few Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs 68.00-69.50. Confirmed - 8,400 Week Ago - 4,400 Year Ago - 4,700
Wk to Date - 22,900 Week Ago - 87,100 Year Ago - 22,500
